description:
How to reproduce:
1. Open the “Scrachpad.zip“ project
2. Open the “SampleScene“
3. Build the project
4. Use both Inputs (white squares on the bottom left and right corners) simultaneously
5. Observe the Player

Expected results: Both Inputs work when used simultaneously
Actual results: Inputs work only when used individually

Reproducible in: 1.7.0, 1.8.0-pre.2, 1.8.1 (2021.3.36f1, 2022.3.21f1, 2023.2.14f1, 6000.0.0b11)

Reproduced on: Windows 11 Pro (23H2)
Not reproduced on: No other environment tested

Notes:

  • When trying to use both Inputs at the same time, sometimes the second input stops responding correctly until restarting the project
  • Even though this was tested on Windows 11 (supporting screen touch), this is very likely reproducible on Android and iOS devices
  • Not reproducible in the Editor (Multitouch is not supported)
title: Multiple elements with "On-Screen Stick" Components do not work together when using them simultaneously
